evidence_classification.description: Forward state-only observation beginning strictly after protocol freeze. No historical date on or before 2026-09-15 New York time may enter prospective inference.

source.closed_day_policy: the acquisition may contain later source bars, but the scorer must hard-truncate anchors to fully completed New York dates as of the recorded run timestamp; an incomplete current New York date is never scored
source.snapshot_policy: each shadow run records client version, requested interval, raw file SHA256, byte size, and scorer commit; every run artifact is preserved separately so a later download cannot replace prior recorded evidence
source.prelaunch_adapter_clarification: made before the prospective start and before any post-start state observation existed; the direct CLI emits Unix-millisecond timestamps and may cap a future date-to request at current time; no candidate parameter or statistical gate changed

observation_grid.baseline_policy: each clock slot is normalized only against its preceding 20 valid same-source observations at that same New York clock slot

state_definition.realized_volatility: square root of sum of squared one-minute log close returns
state_definition.pre_rv_ratio: pre-60m realized volatility divided by trailing 20-valid-observation same-clock median pre-60m realized volatility
state_definition.future_rv_ratio: next-60m realized volatility divided by trailing 20-valid-observation same-clock median next-60m realized volatility
state_definition.future_range_ratio: next-60m high-low range divided by trailing 20-valid-observation same-clock median next-60m range
state_definition.primary_daily_effect: Spearman(pre_rv_ratio, future_rv_ratio) across valid frozen anchors on each complete post-freeze New York date
state_definition.secondary_daily_effect: Spearman(pre_rv_ratio, future_range_ratio) across valid frozen anchors on each complete post-freeze New York date

statistics.permutation_method: 20,000-epoch sign-flip test on completed prospective daily primary effects against frozen positive sign

full_shadow_gate.origin: effect, breadth and significance thresholds retained from the frozen replication gate; calendar-half check converted only to chronological shadow halves because the prospective window has no fixed year end

futility_policy.reason: interim checkpoints are descriptive only; the frozen full-shadow decision is not made before 160 scorable dates

promotion_path_if_full_shadow_passes: separately_freeze any monetization mechanism before its results
development economics on the separately frozen executable mechanism
locked economic validation and independent replication
leverage and live only after all executable gates and separate user approval
